bullets: Acting as shift lead for SOC operations, overseeing real-time alert monitoring, triaging, and incident response, while guiding junior analysts and resolving their queries. Handling ad-hoc client requests including report generation and log extraction for specific servers and security incidents. Evaluate logs generated by various vendor devices like F5 WAF, Guardium DAM, O365Mail Gateway, Sky high secure Proxy, Palo Alto Firewall, Linux OS, Active Directory to support incident resolution. Coordinated with application teams through SOC shared mailbox during incident response, providing clear explanations of security incidents, their impact, and addressing queries to ensure effective remediation. Designed, developed, SIEM detection rules by analyzing attack patterns, threat intelligence feeds, and analyzing real-world attack scenarios to strengthen detection capabilities. Performed network forensic analysis using Vehere PCAP by inspecting full packet captures to identify malicious traffic patterns. Investigated user activities using UEBA (GRA) to detect abnormal behavior patterns and potential insider threats. Analyzed threat advisories from FS-ISAC, Recorded future, and other intelligence sources and performed remediation actions such as IOC blocking and monitoring. Conducted IOC-driven investigations using SIEM and maintained threat intelligence feeds by uploading IOC files into SIEM to enhance detection accuracy. Experience in SIEM administration including log onboarding, platform health monitoring, and troubleshooting on RSA NetWitness. Integrated SIEM alerts with Cortex XSOAR for automated incident handling. Executed predefined SOAR playbooks in Cortex XSOAR to automate initial investigation of alerts such as suspicious IP activity. Performed incident ticket handling and case management in XSOAR, including updating investigation notes and documenting response actions. Conducted in-depth analysis of phishing and spam emails by inspecting headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, and sender reputation using MX Toolbox. Provide security assurance reports, including monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to client. Analyze security risks and compliance failures, providing advice and managing remediation.
Identify security alert using IBM QRadar and escalate them when necessary.
Collaborated with Senior Analyst to ensure security incident are effectively handled and resolved.
Detected security incidents such as brute force attacks, phishing attempts, and suspicious network activity using QRadar correlation rules.
Utilized QRadar features such as Log Activity and Network Activity for in-depth investigation and root cause analysis.
Integrated in-house MDR agent with AISAAC SIEM, validating log flow from endpoints and ensuring accurate event collection for detection use cases.
Performed agent installation via direct and proxy approach, ensuring endpoint compatibility.
Contributed to the creation of reports for senior management, providing insights into asset details of the customer.
Monitored and maintained server performance, ensuring availability of critical infrastructure.
Configured and managed Active Directory (AD), Domain Controllers (DC), and user access policies.
Performed basic Linux administration, including service monitoring, log analysis, and user management.
Handled VMware ESXi server setup and virtual machine management to support infrastructure operations.
